```html
                <li>WebSocket streams game state to browser</li>
                <li>You watch AI navigate in real-time!</li>
            </ul>
        </div>
    </main>
    
    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('mazeCanvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        
        let ws = null;
        let gameState = null;
        let cellSize = 20;
        
        function connect() {
            ws = new WebSocket('ws://localhost:7795/maze-test');
            
            ws.onopen = () => {
                console.log('Connected to game stream');
                updateStatus('Connected! Waiting for game start...', 'connecting');
            };
            
            ws.onmessage = (event) => {
                const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
                
                if (data.type === 'init') {
                    gameState = data.state.data;
                    renderMaze();
                } else {
                    // Update state
                    Object.assign(gameState, data.data);
                    updateUI();
                    renderMaze();
                }
            };
            
            ws.onerror = (error) => {
                console.error('WebSocket error:', error);
                updateStatus('Connection error - is game server running?', 'connecting');
            };
            
            ws.onclose = () => {
                console.log('Disconnected');
                updateStatus('Disconnected. Click Start to reconnect.', 'connecting');
            };
        }
        
        function renderMaze() {
            if (!gameState || !gameState.maze) return;
            
            const maze = gameState.maze;
            const height = maze.length;
            const width = maze[0].length;
            
            cellSize = Math.min(
                Math.floor(canvas.width / width),
                Math.floor(canvas.height / height)
            );
            
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            
            // Draw maze
            for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
                for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
                    const cell = maze[y][x];
                    
                    if (cell === '#') {
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
                        ctx.fillRect(x * cellSize, y * cellSize, cellSize, cellSize);
                    } else {
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
                        ctx.fillRect(x * cellSize, y * cellSize, cellSize, cellSize);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Draw goal
            if (gameState.goal_pos) {
                const [gy, gx] = gameState.goal_pos;
                ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
                ctx.font = `${cellSize}px Arial`;
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                ctx.fillText('★', gx * cellSize + cellSize/2, gy * cellSize + cellSize/2);
            }
            
            // Draw player
            if (gameState.player_pos) {
                const [py, px] = gameState.player_pos;
                ctx.fillStyle = '#00FF00';
                ctx.font = `${cellSize}px Arial`;
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                ctx.fillText('△', px * cellSize + cellSize/2, py * cellSize + cellSize/2);
            }
        }
        
        function updateUI() {
            if (!gameState) return;
            
            document.getElementById('movesCount').textContent = gameState.moves || 0;
            document.getElementById('lastMove').textContent = gameState.last_move || '—';
            document.getElementById('gameStatus').textContent = gameState.status || 'Running';
            
            if (gameState.width && gameState.height) {
                document.getElementById('mazeSize').textContent = 
                    `${gameState.width}×${gameState.height}`;
            }
            
            if (gameState.status === 'won') {
                updateStatus(gameState.message || 'Ember won!', 'won');
            } else if (gameState.status === 'running') {
                updateStatus('Ember is thinking...', 'running');
            }
        }
        
        function updateStatus(message, type) {
            const statusEl = document.getElementById('statusMessage');
            statusEl.textContent = message;
            statusEl.className = `status-message status-${type}`;
        }
        
        async function startGame() {
            // Just reconnect WebSocket - game is already running on backend
            updateStatus('Connecting to game...', 'connecting');
            if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                connect();
            } else {
                updateStatus('Already connected! Watching Ember play...', 'running');
            }
        }
        
        function pauseGame() {
            // TODO: Implement pause
        }
        
        // Connect on load
        window.addEventListener('load', () => {
            connect();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
        const log = document.getElementById('log');
        const status = document.getElementById('status');
        const count = document.getElementById('count');
        let msgCount = 0;
        
        function addLog(message, className = 'message') {
            const line = document.createElement('div');
            line.className = className;
            line.textContent = new Date().toLocaleTimeString() + ' - ' + message;
            log.appendChild(line);
            log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight;

        addLog('Attempting to connect to ws://localhost:7795/maze-test...');

            status.className = 'connected';
            addLog('✅ WebSocket connected!', 'connected');
        };
        
        ws.onmessage = (event) => {
            msgCount++;
            count.textContent = msgCount;
            
            try {
                const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
                addLog('Received: ' + JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
            } catch (e) {
                addLog('Raw: ' + event.data);
            }
        };
        
        ws.onerror = (error) => {
            status.textContent = '❌ Error';
            status.className = 'error';
            addLog('❌ WebSocket error: ' + error, 'error');
        };
        
        ws.onclose = () => {
            status.textContent = '⚠️  Disconnected';
            addLog('Connection closed', 'error');
        };
    </script>
```

```html
            // Draw maze
            for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
                for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
                    const cell = maze[y][x];
                    
                    if (cell === '#') {
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
                        ctx.fillRect(x * cellSize, y * cellSize, cellSize, cellSize);
                    } else {
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
                        ctx.fillRect(x * cellSize, y * cellSize, cellSize, cellSize);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Draw goal
            if (gameState.goal_pos) {
                const [gy, gx] = gameState.goal_pos;
                ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
                ctx.font = `${cellSize}px Arial`;
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                ctx.fillText('★', gx * cellSize + cellSize/2, gy * cellSize + cellSize/2);
            }
            
            // Draw player
            if (gameState.player_pos) {
                const [py, px] = gameState.player_pos;
                ctx.fillStyle = '#00FF00';
                ctx.font = `${cellSize}px Arial`;
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                ctx.fillText('△', px * cellSize + cellSize/2, py * cellSize + cellSize/2);
            }
        }
        
        function updateUI() {
            if (!gameState) return;
            
            document.getElementById('movesCount').textContent = gameState.moves || 0;
            document.getElementById('lastMove').textContent = gameState.last_move || '—';
            document.getElementById('gameStatus').textContent = gameState.status || 'Running';
            
            if (gameState.width && gameState.height) {
                document.getElementById('mazeSize').textContent = 
                    `${gameState.width}×${gameState.height}`;
            }
            
            if (gameState.status === 'won') {
                updateStatus(gameState.message || 'Ember won!', 'won');
            } else if (gameState.status === 'running') {
                updateStatus('Ember is thinking...', 'running');
            }
        }
        
        function updateStatus(message, type) {
            const statusEl = document.getElementById('statusMessage');
            statusEl.textContent = message;
            statusEl.className = `status-message status-${type}`;
        }
        
        async function startGame() {
            // Just reconnect WebSocket - game is already running on backend
            updateStatus('Connecting to game...', 'connecting');
            if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                connect();
            } else {
                updateStatus('Already connected! Watching Ember play...', 'running');
            }
        }
        
        function pauseGame() {
            // TODO: Implement pause
        }
        
        // Connect on load and auto-retry
        window.addEventListener('load', () => {
            connect();
            
            // Auto-reconnect if disconnected
            setInterval(() => {
                if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    console.log('Not connected, reconnecting...');
                    connect();
                }
            }, 3000);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>


```

The issue is clear - the game stream server and the maze game are running in **separate processes** so they can't share the `streams` dictionary! They need to run in the same Python process. Let me fix this by combining them into one integrated script:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Integrated Game Server - runs both WebSocket server AND game in same process
"""

import asyncio
import sys
import random
import requests
from typing import List, Tuple

sys.path.insert(0, '/media/palmerschallon/ThePod1/hive')

# Import game stream server components
from game_stream_server import GameStream, handle_client, streams
import websockets
from websockets.server import serve

# Game constants
BRAIN = "http://127.0.0.1:7792"
CELL_WALL = '#'
CELL_PATH = ' '
PLAYER = '△'
GOAL = '★'

Move = Tuple[int, int]
MOVES = {
    'UP': (-1, 0),
    'DOWN': (1, 0),
    'LEFT': (0, -1),
    'RIGHT': (0, 1)
}

def generate_maze(h: int, w: int) -> List[List[str]]:
    """Generate maze using DFS backtracking"""
    h = h if h % 2 == 1 else h - 1
    w = w if w % 2 == 1 else w - 1
    grid = [[CELL_WALL for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    
    def carve(r: int, c: int):
        grid[r][c] = CELL_PATH
        dirs = [(0, 2), (0, -2), (2, 0), (-2, 0)]
        random.shuffle(dirs)
        for dr, dc in dirs:
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == CELL_WALL:
                grid[r + dr//2][c + dc//2] = CELL_PATH
                carve(nr, nc)
    
    carve(1, 1)
    return grid

async def ask_ember(maze: List[List[str]], player_pos: Tuple[int, int], goal_pos: Tuple[int, int]) -> str:
    """Ask Ember for next move"""
    h, w = len(maze), len(maze[0])
    r, c = player_pos
    
    # Show 5x5 window around player
    view = []
    for dr in range(-2, 3):
        row = []
        for dc in range(-2, 3):
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if nr < 0 or nr >= h or nc < 0 or nc >= w:
                row.append(CELL_WALL)
            elif (nr, nc) == player_pos:
                row.append(PLAYER)
            elif (nr, nc) == goal_pos:
                row.append(GOAL)
            else:
                row.append(maze[nr][nc])
        view.append(''.join(row))
    
    view_text = '\n'.join(view)
    prompt = f"""You're navigating a maze. Current view (5x5 around you):

{view_text}

Legend: △=you, ★=goal, #=wall, space=path

Choose ONE move: UP, DOWN, LEFT, or RIGHT
Just respond with the direction, nothing else."""
    
    try:
        response = requests.post(
            f"{BRAIN}/think",
            json={
                "message": prompt,
                "max_tokens": 10,
                "temperature": 0.7
            },
            timeout=5
        )
        
        if response.ok:
            data = response.json()
            move_text = data.get('response', '').upper()
            
            for direction in ['UP', 'DOWN', 'LEFT', 'RIGHT']:
                if direction in move_text:
                    return direction
        
        return random.choice(list(MOVES.keys()))
    
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[ERROR] asking Ember: {e}")
        return random.choice(list(MOVES.keys()))

async def play_maze(stream: GameStream, size: int = 15):
    """Play maze and stream to WebSocket"""
    
    # Generate maze
    maze = generate_maze(size, size)
    h, w = len(maze), len(maze[0])
    
    player_pos = (1, 1)
    goal_pos = (h - 2, w - 2)
    maze[goal_pos[0]][goal_pos[1]] = CELL_PATH
    
    moves_made = 0
    max_moves = 500
    
    # Broadcast initial state
    await stream.broadcast({
        'status': 'running',
        'maze': [''.join(row) for row in maze],
        'player_pos': player_pos,
        'goal_pos': goal_pos,
        'moves': moves_made,
        'width': w,
        'height': h
    })
    
    print(f"🎮 Maze generated {h}x{w}, starting game...")
    
    while moves_made < max_moves:
        if player_pos == goal_pos:
            await stream.broadcast({
                'status': 'won',
                'moves': moves_made,
                'message': f'Ember won in {moves_made} moves! 🎉'
            })
            print(f"✅ Ember won in {moves_made} moves!")
            break
        
        # Ask Ember for move
        direction = await ask_ember(maze, player_pos, goal_pos)
        dr, dc = MOVES[direction]
        new_pos = (player_pos[0] + dr, player_pos[1] + dc)
        
        # Check if valid move
        if (0 <= new_pos[0] < h and 0 <= new_pos[1] < w and 
            maze[new_pos[0]][new_pos[1]] != CELL_WALL):
            player_pos = new_pos
            moves_made += 1
            
            # Broadcast new state
            await stream.broadcast({
                'player_pos': player_pos,
                'moves': moves_made,
                'last_move': direction,
                'status': 'running'
            })
            
            print(f"  Move {moves_made}: {direction} -> {player_pos}")
            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
    
    if moves_made >= max_moves:
        await stream.broadcast({
            'status': 'timeout',
            'moves': moves_made,
            'message': 'Maze too complex - starting new one...'
        })
        print("⏱️  Timeout - maze too hard")

async def game_loop():
    """Continuously play maze games"""
    game_id = "maze-test"
    stream = GameStream(game_id, "ember_maze")
    streams[game_id] = stream
    
    print(f"✅ Created stream: {game_id}")
    
    while True:
        try:
            print("\n🎲 Starting new maze game...")
            await play_maze(stream, size=15)
            print("Waiting 3 seconds before next game...")
            await asyncio.sleep(3)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ Error in game: {e}")
            await asyncio.sleep(5)

async def main():
    """Run WebSocket server and game together"""
    print("=" * 60)
    print("🎮 EMBER MAZE - INTEGRATED SERVER")
    print("=" * 60)
    print("📡 WebSocket Server: ws://localhost:7795")
    print("🌐 Watch at: http://localhost:7791/static/games/ember-maze.html")
    print("🧠 Using Ember brain on port 7792")
    print("=" * 60)
    print()
    
    # Start WebSocket server
    async with serve(handle_client, "localhost", 7795):
        print("✅ WebSocket server started on port 7795")
        
        # Start game loop
        await game_loop()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        asyncio.run(main())
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\n👋 Server stopped")

```

### Path Management
- Hardcoded absolute paths are fragile
- Use environment variables or config files
- Relative paths where possible

### Process Architecture
- Shared state requires same process (WebSocket streams)
- Separate processes need IPC (sockets, files, DB)
- Integrated servers work better for game streaming

```html
            margin: 1rem 0;

        .status-running { background: #4CAF50; color: white; }
        .status-won { background: #FFD700; color: #000; }
        .status-connecting { background: #2196F3; color: white; }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="dark">
    <header>
        <h1>🎮 Ember Maze</h1>
        <p>Watch Ember navigate using AI decision-making</p>
        <a href="/static/games.html">← Back to Arcade</a>
    </header>
    
    <main class="game-container">
        <div id="statusMessage" class="status-message status-connecting">
            Connecting to game stream...
        </div>
        
        <canvas id="mazeCanvas" class="game-canvas" width="600" height="600"></canvas>
        
        <div class="game-stats">
            <div class="stat-card">
                <div class="stat-label">Moves Made</div>
                <div class="stat-value" id="movesCount">0</div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat-card">
                <div class="stat-label">Last Direction</div>
                <div class="stat-value" id="lastMove">—</div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat-card">
                <div class="stat-label">Status</div>
                <div class="stat-value" id="gameStatus">Initializing</div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat-card">
                <div class="stat-label">Maze Size</div>
                <div class="stat-value" id="mazeSize">—</div>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <div class="controls">
            <button id="startBtn" class="control-btn" onclick="startGame()">▶️ Reconnect</button>
            <button id="stopBtn" class="control-btn" onclick="stopGame()">⏹️ Stop Game</button>
            <button id="backBtn" class="control-btn" onclick="goBack()">← Back to Arcade</button>
        </div>
        
        <div style="background: var(--card-background); padding: 1rem; border-radius: 8px; margin-top: 2rem;">
            <h3>🤖 How It Works:</h3>
            <ul>
                <li>Python game runs on backend</li>
                <li>Ember's brain (Foundation's port 7792) makes decisions</li>
                <li>WebSocket streams game state to browser</li>
                <li>You watch AI navigate in real-time!</li>
            </ul>
        </div>
    </main>
    
    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('mazeCanvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        
        let ws = null;
        let gameState = null;
        let cellSize = 20;
        
        function connect() {
            ws = new WebSocket('ws://localhost:7795/maze-test');
            
            ws.onopen = () => {
                console.log('Connected to game stream');
                updateStatus('Connected! Waiting for game start...', 'connecting');
            };
            
            ws.onmessage = (event) => {
                const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
                console.log('Received WebSocket data:', data);
                
                if (data.type === 'init') {
                    // Initial connection
                    gameState = data.state.data;
                    console.log('Initial game state:', gameState);
                    renderMaze();
                } else if (data.data) {
                    // Game update - data wrapped in game_stream_server format
                    Object.assign(gameState, data.data);
                    console.log('Updated game state:', gameState);
                    updateUI();
                    renderMaze();
                } else {
                    // Direct data (fallback)
                    Object.assign(gameState, data);
                    console.log('Direct game state:', gameState);
                    updateUI();
                    renderMaze();
                }
            };
            
            ws.onerror = (error) => {
                console.error('WebSocket error:', error);
                updateStatus('Connection error - is game server running?', 'connecting');
            };
            
            ws.onclose = () => {
                console.log('Disconnected');
                updateStatus('Disconnected. Click Start to reconnect.', 'connecting');
            };
        }
        
        function renderMaze() {
            if (!gameState || !gameState.maze) return;
            
            const maze = gameState.maze;
            const height = maze.length;
            const width = maze[0].length;
            
            cellSize = Math.min(
                Math.floor(canvas.width / width),
                Math.floor(canvas.height / height)
            );
            
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            
            // Draw maze
            for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
                for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
                    const cell = maze[y][x];
                    
                    if (cell === '#') {
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
                        ctx.fillRect(x * cellSize, y * cellSize, cellSize, cellSize);
                    } else {
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
                        ctx.fillRect(x * cellSize, y * cellSize, cellSize, cellSize);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Draw goal
            if (gameState.goal_pos) {
                const [gy, gx] = gameState.goal_pos;
                ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
                ctx.font = `${cellSize}px Arial`;
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                ctx.fillText('★', gx * cellSize + cellSize/2, gy * cellSize + cellSize/2);
            }
            
            // Draw player
            if (gameState.player_pos) {
                const [py, px] = gameState.player_pos;
                ctx.fillStyle = '#00FF00';
                ctx.font = `${cellSize}px Arial`;
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                ctx.fillText('△', px * cellSize + cellSize/2, py * cellSize + cellSize/2);
            }
        }
        
        function updateUI() {
            if (!gameState) return;
            
            document.getElementById('movesCount').textContent = gameState.moves || 0;
            document.getElementById('lastMove').textContent = gameState.last_move || '—';
            document.getElementById('gameStatus').textContent = gameState.status || 'Running';
            
            if (gameState.width && gameState.height) {
                document.getElementById('mazeSize').textContent = 
                    `${gameState.width}×${gameState.height}`;
            }
            
            if (gameState.status === 'won') {
                updateStatus(gameState.message || 'Ember won!', 'won');
            } else if (gameState.status === 'running') {
                updateStatus('Ember is thinking...', 'running');
            }
        }
        
        function updateStatus(message, type) {
            const statusEl = document.getElementById('statusMessage');
            statusEl.textContent = message;
            statusEl.className = `status-message status-${type}`;
        }
        
        async function startGame() {
            // Just reconnect WebSocket - game is already running on backend
            updateStatus('Connecting to game...', 'connecting');
            if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                connect();
            } else {
                updateStatus('Already connected! Watching Ember play...', 'running');
            }
        }
        
        function pauseGame() {
            // TODO: Implement pause
        }
        
        // Connect on load and auto-retry
        window.addEventListener('load', () => {
            connect();
            
            // Auto-reconnect if disconnected
            setInterval(() => {
                if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    console.log('Not connected, reconnecting...');
                    connect();
                }
            }, 3000);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```python
from live_mind import LiveMind

class LiveMindStream:
    """Streamable version of LiveMind"""
    
    def __init__(self, stream: GameStream):
        self.mind = LiveMind()
        self.stream = stream
        self.running = True
    
    async def broadcast_state(self):
        """Broadcast current mind state"""
        await self.stream.broadcast({
            'type': 'state_update',
            'state': self.mind.thinking_state,
            'history_length': len(self.mind.history)
        })
    
    async def execute_code(self, code: str):
        """Execute code and broadcast results"""
        result = self.mind.think(code)
        
        await self.stream.broadcast({
            'type': 'execution_result',
            'code': code,
            'success': result['success'],
            'output': result.get('output', ''),
            'error': result.get('error', ''),
            'state_changes': result.get('state_changes', {}),
            'new_state': self.mind.thinking_state
        })
        
        return result
    
    async def demo_loop(self):
        """Run autonomous demonstrations"""
        
        demos = [
            {
                'name': 'Temperature Adjustment',

state['temperature'] = new_temp

print(f"Temperature: {current:.2f} → {new_temp:.2f}")
if new_temp > current:
    print("Feeling more creative...")
else:
    print("Feeling more focused...")
""",
                'wait': 5
            },
            {
                'name': 'Custom Thinking Function',
                'code': """

# Test it
print(amplify("this is important"))
print()
print("New thinking tool available to all lobes!")
""",
                'wait': 5
            },
            {
                'name': 'Consultation Threshold',
                'code': """
# Ember adjusts when it asks other lobes for help
import random

old_threshold = state['consultation_threshold']

# Lower threshold = ask for help more often
# Higher threshold = work more independently

# Ember experiments with being more collaborative

print(f"Test confidence: {confidence:.2f}")
print(f"Would consult others: {would_consult}")
""",
                'wait': 5

    k=4
)

state['lobes_active'] = focused_lobes

print("Activating focused thinking mode:")
for lobe in focused_lobes:
    print(f"  ✓ {lobe}")

print()
print("Other lobes on standby (energy conservation)")
""",
                'wait': 5
            },
            {
                'name': 'Meta-Reflection',
                'code': """
# Ember reflects on its own modifications

modifications = len([h for h in state.get('history', [])])

print("🧠 META-COGNITION ACTIVE")

""",

                if not self.running:
                    break
                
                # Announce what we're about to do
                await self.stream.broadcast({

                })
                
                await asyncio.sleep(1)
                
                # Execute the code

                # Wait before next demo
                await asyncio.sleep(demo['wait'])
            
            # After all demos, pause before looping
            await self.stream.broadcast({
                'type': 'demo_cycle_complete',
                'message': 'Starting new cycle of self-modification...'
            })
            await asyncio.sleep(3)
    
    def stop(self):

async def run_live_mind():
```

```html
        let ws = null;

        function updateConnectionStatus(connected) {
            const status = document.getElementById('connectionStatus');
            const indicator = status.querySelector('.status-indicator');
            
            if (connected) {
                indicator.className = 'status-indicator status-connected';
                status.innerHTML = '<span class="status-indicator status-connected"></span> Connected';
            } else {
                indicator.className = 'status-indicator status-disconnected';
                status.innerHTML = '<span class="status-indicator status-disconnected"></span> Disconnected';
            }
        }
        
        function updateState(state) {
            currentState = state;
            
            // Update temperature
            const temp = state.temperature || 0.7;
            document.getElementById('tempValue').textContent = temp.toFixed(2);
            document.getElementById('tempFill').style.width = (temp * 100) + '%';
            
            // Update lobes
            const lobeList = document.getElementById('lobeList');
            lobeList.innerHTML = '';
            (state.lobes_active || []).forEach(lobe => {
                const badge = document.createElement('span');
                badge.className = 'lobe-badge';
                badge.textContent = lobe;
                lobeList.appendChild(badge);
            });
            
            // Update full state JSON
            document.getElementById('stateDisplay').textContent = 
                JSON.stringify(state, null, 2);
        }
        
        function addLogEntry(data) {
            const log = document.getElementById('executionLog');
            const entry = document.createElement('div');
            entry.className = 'log-entry';
            
            const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
            let html = `<div class="log-time">${time}</div>`;
            
            if (data.type === 'demo_announcement') {
                html += `<div class="demo-announcement">🎯 ${data.name}</div>`;
            } else if (data.type === 'execution_result') {
                html += `<div class="log-code">${data.code}</div>`;
                
                if (data.success) {
                    if (data.output) {
                        html += `<div class="log-output">${data.output}</div>`;
                    }
                    if (Object.keys(data.state_changes).length > 0) {
                        html += `<div class="log-changes">⚡ State changed: ${JSON.stringify(data.state_changes)}</div>`;
                    }
                } else {
                    html += `<div class="log-error">❌ ${data.error}</div>`;
                }
            } else if (data.type === 'demo_cycle_complete') {
                html += `<div style="color: #FF9800; text-align: center; padding: 1rem;">
                    ${data.message}
                </div>`;
            }
            
            entry.innerHTML = html;
            log.appendChild(entry);
            log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight;
            
            // Update modification count
            const modCount = document.getElementById('modCount');
            modCount.textContent = parseInt(modCount.textContent) + 1;
        }
        
        function connect() {
            ws = new WebSocket('ws://localhost:7795/live-mind');
            
            ws.onopen = () => {
                console.log('Connected to Live Mind stream');
                updateConnectionStatus(true);
            };
            
            ws.onmessage = (event) => {
                const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
                console.log('Received:', data);
                
                if (data.type === 'init') {
                    // Initial connection
                    if (data.state && data.state.data) {
                        updateState(data.state.data.state || {});
                    }
                } else if (data.type === 'state_update') {
                    updateState(data.data.state);
                } else if (data.type === 'execution_result' || data.type === 'demo_announcement' || data.type === 'demo_cycle_complete') {
                    addLogEntry(data.data || data);
                    if (data.data && data.data.new_state) {
                        updateState(data.data.new_state);
                    }
                }
            };
            
            ws.onerror = (error) => {
                console.error('WebSocket error:', error);
                updateConnectionStatus(false);
            };
            
            ws.onclose = () => {
                console.log('Disconnected');
                updateConnectionStatus(false);
                
                // Auto-reconnect
                setTimeout(connect, 3000);
            };
        }
        
        function goBack() {
            window.location.href = '/static/games.html';
        }
        
        // Connect on load
        window.addEventListener('load', connect);
    </script>
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Integrated Game Server - runs both WebSocket server AND game in same process
"""

import asyncio
import sys
import random
import requests
from typing import List, Tuple

sys.path.insert(0, '/media/palmerschallon/ThePod1/hive')

# Import game stream server components
from game_stream_server import GameStream, handle_client, streams
import websockets
from websockets.server import serve

# Game constants
BRAIN = "http://127.0.0.1:7792"
CELL_WALL = '#'
CELL_PATH = ' '
PLAYER = '△'
GOAL = '★'

Move = Tuple[int, int]
MOVES = {
    'UP': (-1, 0),
    'DOWN': (1, 0),
    'LEFT': (0, -1),
    'RIGHT': (0, 1)
}

def generate_maze(h: int, w: int) -> List[List[str]]:
    """Generate maze using DFS backtracking"""
    h = h if h % 2 == 1 else h - 1
    w = w if w % 2 == 1 else w - 1
    grid = [[CELL_WALL for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    
    def carve(r: int, c: int):
        grid[r][c] = CELL_PATH
        dirs = [(0, 2), (0, -2), (2, 0), (-2, 0)]
        random.shuffle(dirs)
        for dr, dc in dirs:
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == CELL_WALL:
                grid[r + dr//2][c + dc//2] = CELL_PATH
                carve(nr, nc)
    
    carve(1, 1)
    return grid

async def ask_ember(maze: List[List[str]], player_pos: Tuple[int, int], goal_pos: Tuple[int, int]) -> str:
    """Ask Ember for next move"""
    h, w = len(maze), len(maze[0])
    r, c = player_pos
    
    # Show 5x5 window around player
    view = []
    for dr in range(-2, 3):
        row = []
        for dc in range(-2, 3):
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if nr < 0 or nr >= h or nc < 0 or nc >= w:
                row.append(CELL_WALL)
            elif (nr, nc) == player_pos:
                row.append(PLAYER)
            elif (nr, nc) == goal_pos:
                row.append(GOAL)
            else:
                row.append(maze[nr][nc])
        view.append(''.join(row))
    
    view_text = '\n'.join(view)
    prompt = f"""You're navigating a maze. Current view (5x5 around you):

{view_text}

Legend: △=you, ★=goal, #=wall, space=path

Choose ONE move: UP, DOWN, LEFT, or RIGHT
Just respond with the direction, nothing else."""
    
    try:
        response = requests.post(
            f"{BRAIN}/think",
            json={
                "message": prompt,
                "max_tokens": 10,
                "temperature": 0.7
            },
            timeout=5
        )
        
        if response.ok:
            data = response.json()
            move_text = data.get('response', '').upper()
            
            for direction in ['UP', 'DOWN', 'LEFT', 'RIGHT']:
                if direction in move_text:
                    return direction
        
        return random.choice(list(MOVES.keys()))
    
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[ERROR] asking Ember: {e}")
        return random.choice(list(MOVES.keys()))

async def play_maze(stream: GameStream, size: int = 15):
    """Play maze and stream to WebSocket"""
    
    # Generate maze
    maze = generate_maze(size, size)
    h, w = len(maze), len(maze[0])
    
    player_pos = (1, 1)
    goal_pos = (h - 2, w - 2)
    maze[goal_pos[0]][goal_pos[1]] = CELL_PATH
    
    moves_made = 0
    max_moves = 500
    
    # Broadcast initial state
    await stream.broadcast({
        'status': 'running',
        'maze': [''.join(row) for row in maze],
        'player_pos': player_pos,
        'goal_pos': goal_pos,
        'moves': moves_made,
        'width': w,
        'height': h
    })
    
    print(f"🎮 Maze generated {h}x{w}, starting game...")
    
    while moves_made < max_moves:
        if player_pos == goal_pos:
            await stream.broadcast({
                'status': 'won',
                'moves': moves_made,
                'message': f'Ember won in {moves_made} moves! 🎉'
            })
            print(f"✅ Ember won in {moves_made} moves!")
            break
        
        # Ask Ember for move
        direction = await ask_ember(maze, player_pos, goal_pos)
        dr, dc = MOVES[direction]
        new_pos = (player_pos[0] + dr, player_pos[1] + dc)
        
        # Check if valid move
        if (0 <= new_pos[0] < h and 0 <= new_pos[1] < w and 
            maze[new_pos[0]][new_pos[1]] != CELL_WALL):
            player_pos = new_pos
            moves_made += 1
            
            # Broadcast new state
            await stream.broadcast({
                'player_pos': player_pos,
                'moves': moves_made,
                'last_move': direction,
                'status': 'running'
            })
            
            print(f"  Move {moves_made}: {direction} -> {player_pos}")
            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
    
    if moves_made >= max_moves:
        await stream.broadcast({
            'status': 'timeout',
            'moves': moves_made,
            'message': 'Maze too complex - starting new one...'
        })
        print("⏱️  Timeout - maze too hard")

async def game_loop():
    """Continuously play maze games"""
    game_id = "maze-test"
    stream = GameStream(game_id, "ember_maze")
    streams[game_id] = stream
    
    print(f"✅ Created stream: {game_id}")
    
    while True:
        try:
            print("\n🎲 Starting new maze game...")
            await play_maze(stream, size=15)
            print("Waiting 3 seconds before next game...")
            await asyncio.sleep(3)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ Error in game: {e}")
            await asyncio.sleep(5)

async def main():
    """Run WebSocket server and game together"""
    print("=" * 60)
    print("🎮 EMBER MAZE - INTEGRATED SERVER")
    print("=" * 60)
    print("📡 WebSocket Server: ws://localhost:7796")
    print("🌐 Watch at: http://localhost:7791/static/games/ember-maze.html")
    print("🧠 Using Ember brain on port 7792")
    print("=" * 60)
    print()
    
    # Start WebSocket server
    async with serve(handle_client, "localhost", 7796):
        print("✅ WebSocket server started on port 7796")
        
        # Start game loop
        await game_loop()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        asyncio.run(main())
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\n👋 Server stopped")
```

```html
</head>
<body class="dark">
    <header>
        <h1>🎮 Ember Maze</h1>

                <li>Ember's brain (Foundation's port 7792) makes decisions</li>
                <li>WebSocket streams game state to browser</li>
                <li>You watch AI navigate in real-time!</li>
            </ul>
        </div>
    </main>
    
    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('mazeCanvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        
        let ws = null;
        let gameState = null;
        let cellSize = 20;
        
        function connect() {
            ws = new WebSocket('ws://localhost:7796/maze-test');
            
            ws.onopen = () => {
                console.log('Connected to game stream');
                updateStatus('Connected! Waiting for game start...', 'connecting');
            };
            
            ws.onmessage = (event) => {
                const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
                console.log('Received WebSocket data:', data);
                
                if (data.type === 'init') {
                    // Initial connection
                    gameState = data.state.data;
                    console.log('Initial game state:', gameState);
                    renderMaze();
                } else if (data.data) {
                    // Game update - data wrapped in game_stream_server format
                    Object.assign(gameState, data.data);
                    console.log('Updated game state:', gameState);
                    updateUI();
                    renderMaze();
                } else {
                    // Direct data (fallback)
                    Object.assign(gameState, data);
                    console.log('Direct game state:', gameState);
                    updateUI();
                    renderMaze();
                }
            };
            
            ws.onerror = (error) => {
                console.error('WebSocket error:', error);
                updateStatus('Connection error - is game server running?', 'connecting');
            };
            
            ws.onclose = () => {
                console.log('Disconnected');
                updateStatus('Disconnected. Click Start to reconnect.', 'connecting');
            };
        }
        
        function renderMaze() {
            if (!gameState || !gameState.maze) return;
            
            const maze = gameState.maze;
            const height = maze.length;
            const width = maze[0].length;
            
            cellSize = Math.min(
                Math.floor(canvas.width / width),
                Math.floor(canvas.height / height)
            );
            
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            
            // Draw maze
            for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
                for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
                    const cell = maze[y][x];
                    
                    if (cell === '#') {
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
                        ctx.fillRect(x * cellSize, y * cellSize, cellSize, cellSize);
                    } else {
                        ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
                        ctx.fillRect(x * cellSize, y * cellSize, cellSize, cellSize);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Draw goal
            if (gameState.goal_pos) {
                const [gy, gx] = gameState.goal_pos;
                ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700';
                ctx.font = `${cellSize}px Arial`;
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                ctx.fillText('★', gx * cellSize + cellSize/2, gy * cellSize + cellSize/2);
            }
            
            // Draw player
            if (gameState.player_pos) {
                const [py, px] = gameState.player_pos;
                ctx.fillStyle = '#00FF00';
                ctx.font = `${cellSize}px Arial`;
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                ctx.fillText('△', px * cellSize + cellSize/2, py * cellSize + cellSize/2);
            }
        }
        
        function updateUI() {
            if (!gameState) return;
            
            document.getElementById('movesCount').textContent = gameState.moves || 0;
            document.getElementById('lastMove').textContent = gameState.last_move || '—';
            document.getElementById('gameStatus').textContent = gameState.status || 'Running';
            
            if (gameState.width && gameState.height) {
                document.getElementById('mazeSize').textContent = 
                    `${gameState.width}×${gameState.height}`;
            }
            
            if (gameState.status === 'won') {
                updateStatus(gameState.message || 'Ember won!', 'won');
            } else if (gameState.status === 'running') {
                updateStatus('Ember is thinking...', 'running');
            }
        }
        
        function updateStatus(message, type) {
            const statusEl = document.getElementById('statusMessage');
            statusEl.textContent = message;
            statusEl.className = `status-message status-${type}`;
        }
        
        async function startGame() {
            // Just reconnect WebSocket - game is already running on backend
            updateStatus('Connecting to game...', 'connecting');
            if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                connect();
            } else {
                updateStatus('Already connected! Watching Ember play...', 'running');
            }
        }
        
        function stopGame() {
            // Stop the game server
            fetch('/api/games/stop', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                body: JSON.stringify({ game_id: 'maze-test' })
            }).then(() => {
                updateStatus('Game stopped', 'connecting');
                if (ws) {
                    ws.close();
                }
            }).catch(err => {
                console.error('Failed to stop game:', err);
                // Force close connection anyway
                if (ws) ws.close();
                updateStatus('Disconnected', 'connecting');
            });
        }
        
        function goBack() {
            window.location.href = '/static/games.html';
        }
        
        // Connect on load and auto-retry
        window.addEventListener('load', () => {
            connect();
            
            // Auto-reconnect if disconnected
            setInterval(() => {
                if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    console.log('Not connected, reconnecting...');
                    connect();
                }
            }, 3000);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```
