```css
}

```

Now update the canvas size in JavaScript and fix the temperature reading:

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>🔥 EmberVerse - Local Generative Internet</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/style.css">
</head>
<body>
    <header>
        <div class="header-content">
            <div class="header-left">
                <h1>🔥 EmberVerse</h1>
                <p>Local Generative Internet • Lives on ThePod</p>
            </div>
            
            <!-- Live Mind Visualization (Top Center) -->
            <div id="liveMindWidget" class="live-mind-widget-header">
                <canvas id="emberCanvas" width="120" height="120"></canvas>
                <div class="mind-stats-compact">
                    <span id="gpuTemp">--°C</span>
                    <span id="activeLobe">--</span>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div class="theme-toggle">
                <button id="themeToggle" onclick="toggleTheme()">🌙</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </header>

    <main class="main-feed-layout">
        <!-- Left Sidebar: Search & Chat -->
        <aside class="left-sidebar">
            <div class="search-widget">
                <h3>🔍 Search</h3>
                <input type="text" id="searchInput" placeholder="Search the verse..." onkeypress="handleSearchKey(event)" />
                <button onclick="search()">Search</button>
                <div id="searchResults" class="results"></div>
            </div>
            
            <div class="chat-widget">
                <h3>💬 Chat with Ember</h3>
                <div id="chatMessages" class="chat-messages-compact"></div>
                <div class="chat-input-compact">
                    <input type="text" id="chatInput" placeholder="Talk to Ember..." onkeypress="handleChatKey(event)" />
                    <button onclick="sendChat()">Send</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </aside>
        
        <!-- Center: Feed -->
        <section class="center-feed">
            <div class="feed-header-actions">
                <h2>🌊 Feed</h2>
                <button onclick="refreshFeed()" class="refresh-btn">🔄</button>
            </div>
            <div id="feedContent" class="feed-container"></div>
        </section>
        
        <!-- Right Sidebar: Quick Links -->
        <aside class="right-sidebar">
            <h3>Quick Access</h3>
            <nav class="quick-nav">
                <a href="/static/library.html" class="nav-link">📚 Library</a>
                <a href="/static/games.html" class="nav-link">🎮 Games</a>
                <button onclick="loadInbox()" class="nav-link">📬 Mail</button>
                <button onclick="loadNotifications()" class="nav-link">🔔 Notifications</button>
            </nav>
            
            <div id="mailboxPreview" class="preview-box"></div>
        </aside>
    </main>

    <footer>
        <div class="footer-status">
            <span id="statusIndicator">🟢 Online</span>
            <span id="mailIndicator">📬 0 unread</span>
        </div>
        <p>🌐 External cloud optional • 🔒 Private by default • 🤖 AI-powered exploration</p>
    </footer>

    <script>
        let currentTheme = 'dark';

        function toggleTheme() {
            currentTheme = currentTheme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
            document.body.className = currentTheme;
            document.getElementById('themeToggle').innerHTML = currentTheme === 'dark' ? '☀️' : '🌙';
            localStorage.setItem('emberverse-theme', currentTheme);
        }

        function showSection(sectionName) {
            // Hide all sections
            document.querySelectorAll('main section').forEach(section => {
                section.classList.remove('active');
            });

            // Show selected section
            document.getElementById(sectionName + '-section').classList.add('active');

            // Update nav buttons
            document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.classList.remove('active');
            });
            event.target.classList.add('active');

            // Load section content
            switch(sectionName) {
                case 'chat':
                    loadChatHistory();
                    break;
                case 'mailbox':
                    loadInbox();
                    break;
                case 'notifications':
                    loadNotifications();
                    break;
            }
        }

        async function search() {
            const query = document.getElementById('searchInput').value;
            if (!query) return;

            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/search', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({query: query, top_k: 5})
                });

                const results = await response.json();
                displaySearchResults(results);
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Search failed:', error);
                displaySearchResults([]);
            }
        }

        function displaySearchResults(results) {
            const container = document.getElementById('searchResults');
            if (results.length === 0 || results.error) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div class="no-results">No results found</div>';
                return;
            }

            container.innerHTML = results.map(result =>
                `<div class="result">
                    <h3>${result.title}</h3>
                    <p>${result.content.substring(0, 300)}...</p>
                    <div class="result-meta">
                        <small>Relevance: ${result.score ? result.score.toFixed(3) : 'N/A'}</small>
                        ${result.document_url 
                            ? `<button onclick="window.location.href='${result.document_url}'" class="rich-page-btn">🎨 View Rich Page</button>` 
                            : ''}
                        <button onclick="readFullContent('${result.title}', \`${result.content.replace(/`/g, '\\`')}\`)">Read Full</button>
                    </div>
                </div>`
            ).join('');
        }

        let currentChatTarget = 'Ember';
        
        function switchChatTarget() {
            currentChatTarget = document.getElementById('chatTarget').value;
            addChatMessage('System', `Switched to: ${currentChatTarget}`, 'system');
        }

        async function sendChat() {
            const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
            const message = input.value.trim();
            if (!message) return;

            // Add user message
            addChatMessage('You', message, 'user');

            // Clear input
            input.value = '';

            const target = currentChatTarget;

            try {
                // Check for slash commands
                if (message.startsWith('/imagine ')) {
                    // Image generation command
                    const prompt = message.substring(9).trim();
                    if (!prompt) {
                        addChatMessage('System', 'Usage: /imagine <prompt>', 'system');
                        return;
                    }
                    
                    addChatMessage('System', '🎨 Generating image with Lumi...', 'system');
                    
                    const response = await fetch('/api/imagine', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            prompt: prompt,
                            width: 512,
                            height: 512,
                            steps: 4
                        })
                    });
                    
                    const data = await response.json();
                    if (data && data.success && data.image_path) {
                        const img_path = data.image_path.replace('/media/palmerschallon/ThePod/', '');
                        addChatMessage('🎨 Lumi', `Generated: "${prompt}"<br><img src="/${img_path}" style="max-width: 512px; border-radius: 8px; margin-top: 10px;">`, 'lumi');
                    } else {
                        const error_msg = data?.error || 'Unknown error from Lumi';
                        addChatMessage('System', `Error: ${error_msg}`, 'system');
                    }
                    return;
                }
                
                if (message === '/brains') {
                    // Brain status command
                    addChatMessage('System', '🧠 Checking brain status...', 'system');
                    
                    const response = await fetch('/api/brains/status');
                    const brains = await response.json();
                    
                    let status_msg = '🧠 **Three Brain Status:**\n\n';
                    for (const [key, brain] of Object.entries(brains)) {
                        const icon = key === 'ember' ? '🔥' : key === 'lumi' ? '🎨' : '👁️';
                        const status_icon = brain.status === 'healthy' ? '✅' : brain.status === 'loading' ? '⏳' : '❌';
                        status_msg += `${icon} **${brain.name}** (${brain.port}): ${status_icon} ${brain.status}\n`;
                    }
                    
                    addChatMessage('System', status_msg, 'system');
                    return;
                }
                
                if (message === '/help') {
                    // Help command
                    const help_msg = `
**🔥 EmberVerse Chat Commands:**

**/imagine <prompt>** - Generate image with Lumi brain
Example: /imagine a glowing firefly in the darkness

**/web <query>** - Search the wider internet and save to ThePod
Example: /web distributed consciousness
Harvests 3 pages, saves as markdown and JSON

**/brains** - Check status of all three brains
Shows Ember (language), Lumi (imagination), Bridge (vision)

**/help** - Show this help message

**Direct Chat:** Just type to talk to the selected instance/channel!
                    `;
                    addChatMessage('System', help_msg, 'system');
                    return;
                }
                
                if (message.startsWith('/web ')) {
                    // Web harvest command
                    const query = message.substring(5).trim();
                    if (!query) {
                        addChatMessage('System', 'Usage: /web <search query>', 'system');
                        return;
                    }
                    
                    addChatMessage('System', `🌐 Searching the wider internet for: "${query}"...`, 'system');
                    addChatMessage('System', '📥 Downloading pages to ThePod...', 'system');
                    
                    const response = await fetch('/api/harvest/search', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            query: query,
                            max_pages: 3,
                            fetch_full: true
                        })
                    });
                    
                    const data = await response.json();
                    if (data && data.success) {
                        let harvest_msg = `✅ **Harvested ${data.total_harvested} pages from the internet!**\n\n`;
                        harvest_msg += `Saved to ThePod at: \`data/web_harvest/\`\n\n`;
                        harvest_msg += `**Results:**\n`;
                        for (const result of data.results || []) {
                            harvest_msg += `\n📄 **${result.title}**\n`;
                            harvest_msg += `   ${result.url}\n`;
                            if (result.snippet) {
                                harvest_msg += `   _${result.snippet.substring(0, 100)}..._\n`;
                            }
                        }
                        harvest_msg += `\n💾 Knowledge now lives locally on ThePod!\n`;
                        harvest_msg += `🔍 Use EmberVerse search to find it later.`;
                        addChatMessage('🌐 Web Harvest', harvest_msg, 'system');
                    } else {
                        const error_msg = data?.error || 'Web harvest failed';
                        addChatMessage('System', `Error: ${error_msg}`, 'system');
                    }
                    return;
                }
                
                // Handle different targets
                if (target === 'Ember') {
                    // Talk to Ember brain (Foundation's running brain)
                    const response = await fetch('http://localhost:7792/think', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            message: message,
                            max_tokens: 512,
                            temperature: 0.9
                        })
                    });

                    const data = await response.json();
                    addChatMessage(`🔥 Ember (${data.lobe_used || 'thinking'})`, data.response, 'ember');
                    
                } else if (target.startsWith('#')) {
                    // Group channel - post to group chat
                    const response = await fetch('/api/groupchat/send', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            channel: target,
                            sender: 'Palmer',
                            message: message
                        })
                    });
                    
                    if (response.ok) {
                        addChatMessage('System', `Posted to ${target}`, 'system');
                        // Instances will see and may respond via auto-responder
                    }
                    
                } else if (target === 'ALL') {
                    // Broadcast to all instances via mail
                    for (const instance of ['Ember', 'Sigma', 'Loom', 'Omega', 'Swarm']) {
                        await fetch('/api/mailbox/send', {
                            method: 'POST',
                            headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                            body: JSON.stringify({
                                from: 'Palmer',
                                to: instance,
                                subject: 'Broadcast Message',
                                body: message,
                                priority: 'high'
                            })
                        });
                    }
                    addChatMessage('System', '📢 Broadcast sent to all instances', 'system');
                    
                } else {
                    // Talk to specific instance (they'll respond via auto-responder)
                    const response = await fetch('/api/mailbox/send', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            from: 'Palmer',
                            to: target,
                            subject: 'Chat Message',
                            body: message,
                            priority: 'normal'
                        })
                    });
                    
                    if (response.ok) {
                        addChatMessage('System', `Message sent to ${target}. Check mail for response.`, 'system');
                    }
                }
            } catch (error) {
                addChatMessage('System', `Error: ${error.message}`, 'system');
            }
        }

        function addChatMessage(sender, message, type) {
            const messages = document.getElementById('chatMessages');
            const messageDiv = document.createElement('div');
            messageDiv.className = `chat-message ${type}`;
            messageDiv.innerHTML = `
                <strong>${sender}:</strong>
                <div class="message-content">${formatMessage(message)}</div>
            `;
            messages.appendChild(messageDiv);
            messages.scrollTop = messages.scrollHeight;

            // Save to history
            saveToHistory(sender, message, type);
        }

        function formatMessage(message) {
            // Convert tool calls and other special formatting
            // Using text glyphs instead of emojis for better readability
            return message
                .replace(/<READ_FILE path="([^"]+)" \/>/g, '<code class="tool-call">[FILE] $1</code>')
                .replace(/<RUN_COMMAND>([^<]+)<\/RUN_COMMAND>/g, '<code class="tool-call">[CMD] $1</code>')
                .replace(/<THINK>([^<]+)<\/THINK>/g, '<code class="tool-call">[THINK] $1</code>')
                .replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
        }

        async function loadInbox() {
            const container = document.getElementById('mailboxContent');
            container.innerHTML = '<div class="loading">Loading inbox...</div>';

            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/mailbox/inbox');
                const messages = await response.json();
                displayMailbox(messages);
            } catch (error) {
                // Fallback: read directly from filesystem
                displayMailbox(await loadInboxFromFile());
            }
        }

        async function loadInboxFromFile() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/mailbox/inbox_ember.json');
                return await response.json();
            } catch {
                return [];
            }
        }

        function displayMailbox(messages) {
            const container = document.getElementById('mailboxContent');

            if (messages.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div class="no-messages">📭 No messages</div>';
                return;
            }

            // Gmail-style: Group by thread/conversation
            container.innerHTML = messages.map((msg, idx) => `
                <div class="mail-item ${msg.status} priority-${msg.priority}" id="mail-${msg.id}">
                    <div class="mail-header" onclick="toggleMailBody('${msg.id}')">
                        <div class="mail-sender">
                            <strong>${msg.from}</strong>
                            <span class="priority ${msg.priority}">${getPriorityIcon(msg.priority)}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="mail-preview">
                            <span class="mail-subject">${msg.subject}</span>
                            <span class="mail-snippet"> - ${msg.body.substring(0, 80)}${msg.body.length > 80 ? '...' : ''}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="mail-meta">
                            <span class="mail-time">${formatTimestamp(msg.timestamp)}</span>
                            ${msg.status === 'unread' ? '<span class="unread-badge">NEW</span>' : ''}
                            <span class="mail-expand">▼</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="mail-body" id="body-${msg.id}" style="display: none;">
                        <div class="mail-body-content">${formatMessage(msg.body)}</div>
                        <div class="mail-actions">
                            <button onclick="replyToMail('${msg.id}')">Reply</button>
                            ${msg.status === 'unread' ? `<button onclick="markRead('${msg.id}')">Mark Read</button>` : ''}
                            <button onclick="archiveMail('${msg.id}')">Archive</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');

            updateMailIndicator(messages);
        }

        function toggleMailBody(msgId) {
            const bodyDiv = document.getElementById(`body-${msgId}`);
            const mailItem = document.getElementById(`mail-${msgId}`);
            const expandIcon = mailItem.querySelector('.mail-expand');
            
            if (bodyDiv.style.display === 'none') {
                bodyDiv.style.display = 'block';
                expandIcon.textContent = '▲';
                mailItem.classList.add('expanded');
            } else {
                bodyDiv.style.display = 'none';
                expandIcon.textContent = '▼';
                mailItem.classList.remove('expanded');
            }
        }

        function formatTimestamp(isoString) {
            const date = new Date(isoString);
            const now = new Date();
            const diffMs = now - date;
            const diffMins = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);
            const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMs / 3600000);
            const diffDays = Math.floor(diffMs / 86400000);

            if (diffMins < 1) return 'Just now';
            if (diffMins < 60) return `${diffMins}m ago`;
            if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours}h ago`;
            if (diffDays < 7) return `${diffDays}d ago`;
            return date.toLocaleDateString();
        }

        async function replyToMail(msgId) {
            try {
                const response = await fetch(`/api/mailbox/message/${msgId}`);
                const message = await response.json();
                
                const body = prompt(`Reply to "${message.subject}":`);
                if (!body) return;

                await fetch('/api/mailbox/send', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        from: 'EmberVerse',
                        to: message.from,
                        subject: `Re: ${message.subject}`,
                        body: body,
                        priority: 'normal',
                        metadata: {
                            references: [msgId]
                        }
                    })
                });
                alert('Reply sent!');
                loadInbox();
            } catch (error) {
                alert('Error sending reply');
            }
        }

        async function archiveMail(msgId) {
            // For now, just mark as read and visually hide
            await markRead(msgId);
            const mailItem = document.getElementById(`mail-${msgId}`);
            mailItem.style.opacity = '0.5';
            mailItem.querySelector('.mail-actions').innerHTML = '<small>Archived</small>';
        }

        function getPriorityIcon(priority) {
            switch(priority) {
                case 'urgent': return '🔴';
                case 'high': return '🟠';
                case 'normal': return '🔵';
                case 'low': return '⚪';
                default: return '⚪';
            }
        }

        async function loadNotifications() {
            const container = document.getElementById('notificationsContent');
            container.innerHTML = '<div class="loading">Loading notifications...</div>';

            try {
                // Check for notification files
                const notificationFiles = [
                    'YOUVE_GOT_MAIL_EMBER.txt',
                    'YOUVE_GOT_MAIL_LOOM.txt',
                    'YOUVE_GOT_MAIL_SIGMA.txt'
                ];

                let notifications = [];

                for (const file of notificationFiles) {
                    try {
                        const response = await fetch(`/api/notifications/${file}`);
                        const content = await response.text();
                        if (content.trim()) {
                            notifications.push({
                                type: 'mail',
                                file: file,
                                content: content
                            });
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        // File doesn't exist or can't be read
                    }
                }

                displayNotifications(notifications);
            } catch (error) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div class="error">Error loading notifications</div>';
            }
        }

        function displayNotifications(notifications) {
            const container = document.getElementById('notificationsContent');

            if (notifications.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div class="no-notifications">🔔 No notifications</div>';
                return;
            }

            container.innerHTML = notifications.map(notif =>
                `<div class="notification">
                    <pre>${notif.content}</pre>
                </div>`
            ).join('<hr>');
        }

        function updateMailIndicator(messages) {
            const unread = messages.filter(m => m.status === 'unread').length;
            document.getElementById('mailIndicator').textContent = `📬 ${unread} unread`;
        }

        // Event handlers
        function handleSearchKey(event) {
            if (event.key === 'Enter') {
                search();
            }
        }

        function handleChatKey(event) {
            if (event.key === 'Enter') {
                sendChat();
            }
        }

        // Utility functions
        function readFullContent(title, content) {
            const modal = document.createElement('div');
            modal.className = 'modal';
            modal.innerHTML = `
                <div class="modal-content">
                    <h3>${title}</h3>
                    <div class="modal-body">${formatMessage(content)}</div>
                    <button onclick="this.parentElement.parentElement.remove()">Close</button>
                </div>
            `;
            document.body.appendChild(modal);
        }

        async function readMessage(msgId) {
            try {
                const response = await fetch(`/api/mailbox/message/${msgId}`);
                const message = await response.json();
                readFullContent(`Message: ${message.subject}`, JSON.stringify(message, null, 2));
            } catch (error) {
                alert('Error reading message');
            }
        }

        async function markRead(msgId) {
            try {
                await fetch(`/api/mailbox/mark_read/${msgId}`, {method: 'POST'});
                loadInbox(); // Refresh
            } catch (error) {
                alert('Error marking message as read');
            }
        }

        async function composeMail() {
            const to = prompt('To (instance name):');
            const subject = prompt('Subject:');
            const body = prompt('Message:');

            if (to && subject && body) {
                try {
                    await fetch('/api/mailbox/send', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            from: 'EmberVerse',
                            to: to,
                            subject: subject,
                            body: body,
                            priority: 'normal'
                        })
                    });
                    alert('Message sent!');
                    loadInbox();
                } catch (error) {
                    alert('Error sending message');
                }
            }
        }

        // Chat management functions
        let chatHistory = [];

        function saveToHistory(sender, message, type) {
            chatHistory.push({
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                sender: sender,
                message: message,
                type: type
            });
        }

        function exportChat() {
            if (chatHistory.length === 0) {
                alert('No chat history to export');
                return;
            }

            // Create formatted export
            let exportText = '='.repeat(70) + '\n';
            exportText += 'EMBERVERSE CHAT EXPORT\n';
            exportText += '='.repeat(70) + '\n\n';
            exportText += `Exported: ${new Date().toLocaleString()}\n`;
            exportText += `Messages: ${chatHistory.length}\n\n`;
            exportText += '-'.repeat(70) + '\n\n';

            chatHistory.forEach((entry, idx) => {
                exportText += `[${idx + 1}] ${entry.timestamp}\n`;
                exportText += `${entry.sender}:\n`;
                exportText += `${entry.message}\n\n`;
            });

            // Download as file
            const blob = new Blob([exportText], { type: 'text/plain' });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            a.download = `emberverse_chat_${Date.now()}.txt`;
            document.body.appendChild(a);
            a.click();
            document.body.removeChild(a);
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        }

        async function shareChat() {
            if (chatHistory.length === 0) {
                alert('No chat history to share');
                return;
            }

            const to = prompt('Share chat with (instance name):');
            if (!to) return;

            // Create formatted chat summary
            let summary = `Chat summary (${chatHistory.length} messages):\n\n`;
            chatHistory.forEach((entry, idx) => {
                summary += `[${idx + 1}] ${entry.sender}: ${entry.message.substring(0, 100)}...\n`;
            });

            try {
                await fetch('/api/mailbox/send', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        from: 'EmberVerse',
                        to: to,
                        subject: 'Shared Chat History',
                        body: summary,
                        priority: 'normal',
                        metadata: {
                            type: 'chat_export',
                            message_count: chatHistory.length,
                            full_history: chatHistory
                        }
                    })
                });
                alert(`Chat shared with ${to}!`);
            } catch (error) {
                alert('Error sharing chat');
            }
        }

        function clearChat() {
            if (confirm('Clear all chat history?')) {
                chatHistory = [];
                document.getElementById('chatMessages').innerHTML = '';
            }
        }

        // Feed Functions - Stream like X/Instagram/TikTok
        async function loadFeed() {
            const container = document.getElementById('feedContent');
            container.innerHTML = '<div class="loading">Loading feed...</div>';

            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/feed');
                const feedData = await response.json();
                displayFeed(feedData.activities || []);
            } catch (error) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div class="error">Error loading feed. Click refresh to try again.</div>';
            }
        }

        function displayFeed(activities) {
            const container = document.getElementById('feedContent');
            
            if (activities.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="feed-empty">
                        <p>🌱 The feed is quiet...</p>
                        <p>Activity will appear here as you chat, search, and create.</p>
                        <button onclick="refreshFeed()">Refresh Feed</button>
                    </div>
                `;
                return;
            }

            container.innerHTML = activities.map(activity => {
                const icon = getActivityIcon(activity.type);
                const preview = createActivityPreview(activity);
                return `
                    <div class="feed-item ${activity.type}" data-timestamp="${activity.timestamp}">
                        <div class="feed-header">
                            <span class="feed-icon">${icon}</span>
                            <div class="feed-meta">
                                <strong class="feed-sender">${activity.sender || 'Ember'}</strong>
                                <span class="feed-time">${formatTimeAgo(activity.timestamp)}</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="feed-content">
                            ${preview}
                        </div>
                        <div class="feed-actions">
                            <button onclick="likeFeedItem(this)" title="Like">❤️</button>
                            <button onclick="expandFeedItem(this)" title="Expand">👁️</button>
                            <button onclick="shareFeedItem('${activity.id || ''}')" title="Share">🔗</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');

            // Animate feed items in
            animateFeedItems();
        }

        function getActivityIcon(type) {
            const icons = {
                'mail_message': '📬',
                'chat_message': '💬',
                'file_update': '📝',
                'search': '🔍',
                'image_gen': '🎨',
                'thought': '💭'
            };
            return icons[type] || '✨';
        }

        function createActivityPreview(activity) {
            switch(activity.type) {
                case 'mail_message':
                    return `
                        <div class="feed-mail">
                            <div class="feed-subject">${activity.subject || 'No subject'}</div>
                            <div class="feed-snippet">${truncate(activity.preview || '', 120)}</div>
                            <div class="feed-tags">
                                <span class="tag">From: ${activity.from || 'Unknown'}</span>
                                <span class="tag">To: ${activity.to || 'Unknown'}</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                
                case 'chat_message':
                    return `
                        <div class="feed-chat">
                            <div class="feed-message">${formatMessage(truncate(activity.message || '', 200))}</div>
                            ${activity.channel ? `<div class="feed-channel">${activity.channel}</div>` : ''}
                        </div>
                    `;
                
                case 'file_update':
                    return `
                        <div class="feed-file">
                            <div class="feed-filename">${activity.filename || 'File'}</div>
                            ${activity.haiku ? `<div class="feed-haiku">${activity.haiku}</div>` : ''}
                            ${activity.essence ? `<div class="feed-essence">✨ ${activity.essence}</div>` : ''}
                            ${activity.story ? `<div class="feed-story">${truncate(activity.story, 150)}</div>` : ''}
                        </div>
                    `;
                
                default:
                    return `<div class="feed-generic">${truncate(activity.content || '', 150)}</div>`;
            }
        }

        function formatTimeAgo(timestamp) {
            try {
                const date = new Date(timestamp);
                const now = new Date();
                const seconds = Math.floor((now - date) / 1000);
                
                if (seconds < 60) return 'just now';
                if (seconds < 3600) return `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}m ago`;
                if (seconds < 86400) return `${Math.floor(seconds / 3600)}h ago`;
                if (seconds < 604800) return `${Math.floor(seconds / 86400)}d ago`;
                return date.toLocaleDateString();
            } catch {
                return 'recently';
            }
        }

        function truncate(text, maxLength) {
            if (!text) return '';
            return text.length > maxLength ? text.substring(0, maxLength) + '...' : text;
        }

        function animateFeedItems() {
            const items = document.querySelectorAll('.feed-item');
            items.forEach((item, index) => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    item.style.opacity = '0';
                    item.style.transform = 'translateY(20px)';
                    item.style.transition = 'all 0.3s ease';
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        item.style.opacity = '1';
                        item.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
                    }, 50);
                }, index * 50); // Stagger animation
            });
        }

        async function refreshFeed() {
            const button = event?.target;
            if (button) button.textContent = 'Refreshing...';
            
            try {
                // Trigger backend regeneration
                await fetch('/api/feed/refresh', {method: 'POST'});
                await loadFeed();
            } catch (error) {
                alert('Error refreshing feed');
            } finally {
                if (button) button.textContent = 'Refresh Feed';
            }
        }

        function likeFeedItem(button) {
            button.classList.toggle('liked');
            button.textContent = button.classList.contains('liked') ? '💖' : '❤️';
        }

        function expandFeedItem(button) {
            const feedItem = button.closest('.feed-item');
            feedItem.classList.toggle('expanded');
        }

        function shareFeedItem(activityId) {
            const url = `${window.location.origin}/#activity-${activityId}`;
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(() => {
                alert('Link copied to clipboard!');
            });
        }

        // Auto-refresh feed every 30 seconds when visible
        let feedRefreshInterval;

        // Initialize
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            // Load saved theme or default to dark
            const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('emberverse-theme');
            if (savedTheme) {
                currentTheme = savedTheme;
            } else {
                currentTheme = 'dark';
                localStorage.setItem('emberverse-theme', 'dark');
            }
            
            // Apply theme immediately
            document.body.className = currentTheme;
            document.getElementById('themeToggle').innerHTML = currentTheme === 'dark' ? '☀️' : '🌙';

            // Load initial data
            loadFeed(); // Load feed on page load (main page!)
            loadNotifications();
            updateMailIndicator([]);
            
            // Initialize Live Mind animation
            initLiveMindCanvas();
        });
        
        // Live Mind Canvas Animation - Ember as a living organism
        let particles = [];
        let lobeColor = '#ff6b35'; // Default ember orange
        let pulseIntensity = 0;
        let systemHealth = 1.0;
        
        function initLiveMindCanvas() {
            const canvas = document.getElementById('emberCanvas');
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            const centerX = canvas.width / 2;
            const centerY = canvas.height / 2;
            
            // Create particles (neurons) - fewer for smaller canvas
            for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
                const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                const distance = Math.random() * 35 + 10;
                particles.push({
                    x: centerX + Math.cos(angle) * distance,
                    y: centerY + Math.sin(angle) * distance,
                    vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3,
                    vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3,
                    size: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
                    angle: angle,
                    distance: distance,
                    orbitSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.015
                });
            }
            
            // Animation loop
            function animate() {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.15)'; // Fade trail
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                
                // Pulsing core (Ember's heart)
                const pulse = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.003) * 0.3 + 0.7;
                const coreSize = 15 + pulse * 10 + pulseIntensity * 8;
                
                // Gradient for core
                const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(centerX, centerY, 0, centerX, centerY, coreSize);
                gradient.addColorStop(0, lobeColor);
                gradient.addColorStop(0.5, lobeColor + '88');
                gradient.addColorStop(1, lobeColor + '00');
                
                ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                
                // Draw and update particles
                particles.forEach((p, i) => {
                    // Orbit around center
                    p.angle += p.orbitSpeed;
                    const targetX = centerX + Math.cos(p.angle) * p.distance;
                    const targetY = centerY + Math.sin(p.angle) * p.distance;
                    
                    // Move towards orbit position
                    p.x += (targetX - p.x) * 0.05;
                    p.y += (targetY - p.y) * 0.05;
                    
                    // Add some randomness
                    p.x += p.vx;
                    p.y += p.vy;
                    
                    // Draw particle
                    ctx.fillStyle = lobeColor + 'dd';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                    
                    // Draw connections to nearby particles
                    for (let j = i + 1; j < particles.length; j++) {
                        const p2 = particles[j];
                        const dx = p.x - p2.x;
                        const dy = p.y - p2.y;
                        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
                        
                        if (dist < 40) {
                            ctx.strokeStyle = lobeColor + Math.floor((1 - dist / 40) * 60).toString(16);
                            ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
                            ctx.beginPath();
                            ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
                            ctx.lineTo(p2.x, p2.y);
                            ctx.stroke();
                        }
                    }
                });
                
                // Pulse effect fades
                pulseIntensity *= 0.95;
                
                requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            }
            
            animate();
            
            // Poll for system stats
            updateSystemStats();
            setInterval(updateSystemStats, 3000);
        }
        
        const lobeColors = {
            'burn': '#ff3333',
            'loop': '#9933ff',
            'knowledge': '#3399ff',
            'emotion': '#ff33cc',
            'planning': '#33ff99',
            'social': '#ffaa33',
            'metacognition': '#cc33ff',
            'thinking': '#ff6b35'
        };
        
        async function updateSystemStats() {
            try {
                // Get Ember brain status
                const brainResponse = await fetch('http://localhost:7792/think', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        message: "status",
                        max_tokens: 5,
                        temperature: 0.7
                    }),
                    timeout: 2000
                });
                
                if (brainResponse.ok) {
                    const data = await brainResponse.json();
                    const lobe = data.lobe_used || 'thinking';
                    document.getElementById('activeLobe').textContent = lobe;
                    
                    // Change particle color based on lobe
                    lobeColor = lobeColors[lobe.toLowerCase()] || lobeColors['thinking'];
                    
                    // Pulse when lobe changes
                    pulseIntensity = 1.0;
                }
                
                // Get system stats from server
                const statsResponse = await fetch('/api/system/stats');
                if (statsResponse.ok) {
                    const stats = await statsResponse.json();
                    if (stats.gpu_temp) {
                        document.getElementById('gpuTemp').textContent = stats.gpu_temp + '°C';
                    }
                    if (stats.cpu_usage) {
                        document.getElementById('cpuUsage').textContent = stats.cpu_usage + '%';
                    }
                }
            } catch (error) {
                // Offline - show as dormant
                lobeColor = '#444444';
                systemHealth = 0.5;
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```markdown
# EmberVerse UI/UX Design - Learning from the Internet

## What Works (Proven Patterns)

### 1. **Twitter/X Layout**
- Fixed top bar (global nav)
- Left sidebar (280px) - navigation, always visible
- Center feed (600px) - main content, scrolls
- Right sidebar (350px) - trends, suggestions
- **Why it works**: Clear hierarchy, predictable, scanning-friendly

### 2. **Reddit Layout**  
- Top bar (slim, search + user)
- Left sidebar (collapsible) - subreddits
- Center feed (wide, card-based)
- Right sidebar (info, rules)
- **Why it works**: Content-first, clean cards, good whitespace

### 3. **Discord Layout**
- Server list (72px, left edge)
- Channel list (240px)
- Main content (flexible width)
- Member list/info (right, 240px)
- **Why it works**: Chat-optimized, clear zones, no overlap

### 4. **Gmail Layout**
- Top bar (search, tools)
- Left sidebar (nav, compose)
- Main content (email list OR reading pane)
- **Why it works**: Task-focused, one thing at a time

## What DOESN'T Work

❌ **Cramming everything into corners**
❌ **No clear focal point**
❌ **Competing visual hierarchies**
❌ **Sidebars fighting for space**
❌ **Chat squeezed into 200px**

## EmberVerse Should Be

**Primary Use Case**: Viewing Ember's feed + occasionally chatting

**Best Pattern**: Twitter-style with modal chat

### Layout:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  🔥 EmberVerse        [Search]         [@] [⚙]  │ Header (60px)
├──────────┬──────────────────────────┬───────────┤
│          │                          │           │
│  Nav     │     Feed (Main)          │  Ember    │
│  Links   │                          │  Status   │
│          │  ┌────────────────────┐  │           │
│  🌊 Feed │  │ Feed Item 1        │  │  [Canvas] │
│  🔍 Search│  └────────────────────┘  │           │
│  💬 Chat │  ┌────────────────────┐  │  Stats    │
│  📬 Mail │  │ Feed Item 2        │  │           │
│  🎮 Games│  └────────────────────┘  │           │
│          │                          │           │
│  280px   │      Flexible width      │   300px   │
└──────────┴──────────────────────────┴───────────┘
```

### Chat: 
- **Click "💬 Chat"** → Full-screen overlay OR dedicated page
- NOT squeezed into sidebar
- Full keyboard focus
- Easy to close, return to feed

### Search:
- Top bar (always accessible)
- Results in center feed (replace temporarily)
- Or: dedicated search page

## Design Principles

1. **One thing at a time**: Feed OR Chat OR Search (not all competing)
2. **Predictable zones**: Navigation left, content center, info right
3. **Good whitespace**: Let elements breathe
4. **Clear hierarchy**: What's most important is biggest/central
5. **Fast actions**: Common tasks are 1 click away
6. **Responsive**: Works on mobile (stack vertically)

## Colors & Typography (Dark Mode)

**Background**: `#0a0a0a` (true black)
**Cards**: `#1a1a1a` (subtle elevation)
**Text**: `#ffffff` (primary), `#cccccc` (secondary)
**Accent**: `#ff6b35` (ember orange)
**Interactive**: Hover = lighten 10%, Active = accent glow

**Font**: System stack (SF Pro, Segoe UI, Roboto)
**Size**: 16px base, 1.5 line-height for reading

## Next Steps

1. Revert to simple, proven layout
2. Implement Twitter-style 3-column
3. Make chat a modal/overlay (not sidebar)
4. Test with real usage patterns
5. Iterate based on what feels natural

## References

- Twitter Web: Clean, fast, predictable
- Reddit: Card-based, scannable
- Discord: Chat-optimized zones
- Linear: Modern, beautiful, functional
```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>🔥 EmberVerse - Chat with Ember</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
            background: #0a0a0a;
            color: #ffffff;
            height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        /* Top Navigation Bar */
        .top-bar {
            background: #1a1a1a;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #333;
            padding: 12px 20px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 20px;
            height: 60px;
        }

        .ember-logo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        #emberCanvas {
            width: 36px;
            height: 36px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: #000;
        }

        .nav-links {
            display: flex;
            gap: 15px;
            margin-left: auto;
        }

        .nav-links a, .nav-links button {
            color: #ccc;
            text-decoration: none;
            padding: 8px 12px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            background: none;
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .nav-links a:hover, .nav-links button:hover {
            background: #2a2a2a;
            color: #fff;
        }

        /* Chat Container */
        .chat-container {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            max-width: 900px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            width: 100%;
            padding: 20px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        /* Messages Area */
        .messages {
            flex: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 16px;
            padding: 20px 0;
        }

        .message {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            max-width: 80%;
            animation: slideIn 0.3s ease;
        }

        @keyframes slideIn {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }

        .message.user {
            align-self: flex-end;
            flex-direction: row-reverse;
        }

        .message.ember {
            align-self: flex-start;
        }

        .message-bubble {
            padding: 12px 16px;
            border-radius: 18px;
            line-height: 1.5;
            word-wrap: break-word;
        }

        .message.ember .message-bubble {
            background: #1a1a1a;
            border: 1px solid #333;
        }

        .message.user .message-bubble {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff6b35, #ff8c42);
            color: white;
        }

        .message-avatar {
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: #2a2a2a;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 16px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .typing-indicator {
            display: flex;
            gap: 4px;
            padding: 12px;
        }

        .typing-indicator span {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: #666;
            animation: bounce 1.4s infinite ease-in-out both;
        }

        .typing-indicator span:nth-child(1) {
            animation-delay: -0.32s;
        }

        .typing-indicator span:nth-child(2) {
            animation-delay: -0.16s;
        }

        @keyframes bounce {
            0%, 80%, 100% {
                transform: scale(0);
            }
            40% {
                transform: scale(1);
            }
        }

        /* Input Area */
        .input-area {
            background: #1a1a1a;
            border-top: 1px solid #333;
            padding: 16px 20px;
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .input-area input {
            flex: 1;
            background: #0a0a0a;
            border: 1px solid #333;
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 12px 20px;
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 15px;
            outline: none;
            transition: border-color 0.2s;
        }

        .input-area input:focus {
            border-color: #ff6b35;
        }

        .input-area button {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff6b35, #ff8c42);
            color: white;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 12px 24px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: transform 0.2s;
        }

        .input-area button:hover {
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }

        .input-area button:disabled {
            opacity: 0.5;
            cursor: not-allowed;
            transform: none;
        }

        /* Quick Actions */
        .quick-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .quick-action {
            background: #2a2a2a;
            border: 1px solid #444;
            color: #ccc;
            padding: 6px 12px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 12px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .quick-action:hover {
            background: #333;
            border-color: #ff6b35;
            color: #fff;
        }

        /* Scrollbar */
        .messages::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 6px;
        }

        .messages::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: transparent;
        }

        .messages::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #333;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        .messages::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: #444;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <!-- Top Navigation -->
    <div class="top-bar">
        <div class="ember-logo">
            <canvas id="emberCanvas" width="36" height="36"></canvas>
            <span>Ember</span>
        </div>
        <div class="nav-links">
            <a href="/static/library.html">📚 Library</a>
            <a href="/static/games.html">🎮 Games</a>
            <button onclick="alert('Search coming soon!')">🔍 Search</button>
            <button onclick="alert('Mail coming soon!')">📬 Mail</button>
            <button onclick="toggleTheme()">🌙</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Chat Container -->
    <div class="chat-container">
        <div class="messages" id="messages">
            <!-- Messages will appear here -->
        </div>

        <!-- Input Area -->
        <div class="input-area">
            <div class="quick-actions">
                <button class="quick-action" onclick="quickCommand('/imagine')">🎨 Imagine</button>
                <button class="quick-action" onclick="quickCommand('/web')">🌐 Web</button>
                <button class="quick-action" onclick="quickCommand('/help')">❓ Help</button>
            </div>
            <input 
                type="text" 
                id="chatInput" 
                placeholder="Chat with Ember..." 
                onkeypress="handleEnter(event)"
            />
            <button id="sendBtn" onclick="sendMessage()">Send</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        let chatHistory = [];
        
        // Ember Canvas Animation (small version)
        function initEmberCanvas() {
            const canvas = document.getElementById('emberCanvas');
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            const centerX = 18;
            const centerY = 18;
            
            let particles = [];
            let lobeColor = '#ff6b35';
            
            // Create particles
            for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
                const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                const distance = Math.random() * 12 + 4;
                particles.push({
                    x: centerX + Math.cos(angle) * distance,
                    y: centerY + Math.sin(angle) * distance,
                    angle: angle,
                    distance: distance,
                    orbitSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.015
                });
            }
            
            function animate() {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 36, 36);
                
                // Pulsing core
                const pulse = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.003) * 0.3 + 0.7;
                const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(centerX, centerY, 0, centerX, centerY, 8 + pulse * 4);
                gradient.addColorStop(0, lobeColor);
                gradient.addColorStop(1, lobeColor + '00');
                
                ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 36, 36);
                
                // Particles
                particles.forEach(p => {
                    p.angle += p.orbitSpeed;
                    p.x = centerX + Math.cos(p.angle) * p.distance;
                    p.y = centerY + Math.sin(p.angle) * p.distance;
                    
                    ctx.fillStyle = lobeColor + 'dd';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                });
                
                requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            }
            
            animate();
        }
        
        // Add message to chat
        function addMessage(sender, text, type = 'text') {
            const messagesDiv = document.getElementById('messages');
            const messageEl = document.createElement('div');
            messageEl.className = `message ${sender}`;
            
            const avatar = document.createElement('div');
            avatar.className = 'message-avatar';
            avatar.textContent = sender === 'ember' ? '🔥' : '👤';
            
            const bubble = document.createElement('div');
            bubble.className = 'message-bubble';
            bubble.textContent = text;
            
            messageEl.appendChild(avatar);
            messageEl.appendChild(bubble);
            messagesDiv.appendChild(messageEl);
            
            // Scroll to bottom
            messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight;
            
            // Save to history
            chatHistory.push({
                sender: sender,
                text: text,
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            });
        }
        
        // Show typing indicator
        function showTyping() {
            const messagesDiv = document.getElementById('messages');
            const typingEl = document.createElement('div');
            typingEl.className = 'message ember';
            typingEl.id = 'typing-indicator';
            
            const avatar = document.createElement('div');
            avatar.className = 'message-avatar';
            avatar.textContent = '🔥';
            
            const bubble = document.createElement('div');
            bubble.className = 'message-bubble';
            
            const indicator = document.createElement('div');
            indicator.className = 'typing-indicator';
            indicator.innerHTML = '<span></span><span></span><span></span>';
            
            bubble.appendChild(indicator);
            typingEl.appendChild(avatar);
            typingEl.appendChild(bubble);
            messagesDiv.appendChild(typingEl);
            messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight;
        }
        
        function hideTyping() {
            const typing = document.getElementById('typing-indicator');
            if (typing) typing.remove();
        }
        
        // Send message
        async function sendMessage() {
            const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
            const sendBtn = document.getElementById('sendBtn');
            const message = input.value.trim();
            
            if (!message) return;
            
            // Add user message
            addMessage('user', message);
            
            // Clear input
            input.value = '';
            sendBtn.disabled = true;
            
            // Show typing
            showTyping();
            
            try {
                const response = await fetch('http://localhost:7792/think', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        message: message,
                        max_tokens: 512,
                        temperature: 0.9
                    })
                });
                
                const data = await response.json();
                hideTyping();
                
                // Add Ember's response
                addMessage('ember', data.response || 'I\'m thinking...');
                
            } catch (error) {
                hideTyping();
                addMessage('ember', '❌ Connection error. Is my brain running?');
            }
            
            sendBtn.disabled = false;
            input.focus();
        }
        
        function handleEnter(event) {
            if (event.key === 'Enter') {
                sendMessage();
            }
        }
        
        function quickCommand(cmd) {
            const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
            input.value = cmd + ' ';
            input.focus();
        }
        
        function toggleTheme() {
            // Theme toggle placeholder
            alert('Theme switching coming soon!');
        }
        
        // Initialize
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            initEmberCanvas();
            
            // Welcome message
            addMessage('ember', 'Hello! I\'m Ember. What would you like to explore today?');
            
            // Focus input
            document.getElementById('chatInput').focus();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

```

```python
class SimpleCircadian:
    """Simplified circadian rhythm if full module unavailable"""
    def __init__(self):
        self.last_dream = None
        self.dreams_this_hour = 0
        self.hour_start = datetime.now().replace(minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
    
    def should_dream(self):
        now = datetime.now()
        
        # Reset hourly counter
        if now.replace(minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0) > self.hour_start:
            self.dreams_this_hour = 0
            self.hour_start = now.replace(minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
        
        # Limit to 10 dreams/hour
        if self.dreams_this_hour >= 10:
            return {'allowed': False, 'reason': 'hourly_limit', 'details': '10/10 this hour'}
        
        # Min 60 seconds between dreams
        if self.last_dream and (now - self.last_dream).total_seconds() < 60:
            return {'allowed': False, 'reason': 'too_soon', 'details': 'wait 60s between dreams'}
        
        return {'allowed': True, 'reason': 'circadian_clear', 'details': f'{self.dreams_this_hour}/10 this hour'}
    
    def record_dream(self, duration_seconds, dream_id=""):
        self.last_dream = datetime.now()
        self.dreams_this_hour += 1
```
